_comment: This is the JSON payload shape emitted by strategy.pine's alert() calls. Point a TradingView webhook alert at your relay/bot endpoint; the relay is responsible for translating this into a real broker order plus its own risk controls (duplicate-alert guard, daily loss limit, kill switch).
relay_responsibilities: Verify the webhook request actually came from TradingView (e.g. shared secret in the URL or a header check) before acting on it.
Reject/deduplicate repeated alerts for the same bar/signal.
Convert 'action' + 'price'/'stop'/'target' into an actual bracket order via your broker's API.
Enforce your own max daily loss / max open positions independent of the strategy.
Log every received alert and resulting order for reconciliation against the TradingView backtest/paper results.
